name: io.github.laxis-tech/laxis-mcp
title: Laxis
description: Search and read your Laxis meeting transcripts, summaries, and participants from Claude and other AI tools.

examples.name: Recall meeting decisions
examples.description: Search your transcripts to find what was decided, agreed, or committed across past calls.

examples.name: Catch up on recent meetings
examples.description: List your recent meetings and summarize the key points and action items.

examples.name: Pull a full transcript
examples.description: Retrieve the participants, AI summary, and full timestamped transcript for a specific meeting.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Laxis personal API key as a Bearer token (e.g. 'Bearer laxis_...'). Generate one at app.laxis.tech -> Settings -> Claude (MCP).
